question: Regarding the definition of chronic kidney disease, one is INCORRECT:

options.opa: It requires persistent presence of structural or functional alterations of the kidney for at least 2 months.
options.opb: It includes alterations in urine as proteinuria, independently of the glomerular filtration rate (GFR).
options.opc: It includes a lower GFR of 60 ml / min / 1.73m2 of body surface regardless of the presence or absence of other markers of kidney damage.
options.opd: It is classified into 5 stages according to the TFG.
options.ope: The preparation for renal replacement therapy should be done in stage 4.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) defined as persistent structural or functional kidney alterations for at least 2 months -> 95% CHAIN: CKD includes alterations in urine such as proteinuria, independent of the glomerular filtration rate (GFR) -> 90% CHAIN: CKD includes a lower GFR of 60 ml/min/1.73m2 regardless of other markers of kidney damage -> 85% CHAIN: CKD is classified into 5 stages according to the GFR -> 95% CHAIN: Preparation for renal replacement therapy should be done in stage 4 of CKD -> 95%
analysis: Chronic kidney disease is defined by the persistent presence of structural or functional alterations of the kidney for at least 3 months, not 2 months as mentioned in option a. The other options are aligned with established definitions of chronic kidney disease.
